entries.name: technology-graph.md
entries.title: Technology Graph
entries.summary: This is everything this repository builds with. It has no runtime and no dependency manifest: the assets are Markdown and JSON, and the platforms below read them. Each technology has one chapter in its layer file; this file is the map.

entries.name: shared.md
entries.title: Shared
entries.summary: These formats and protocols cut across every layer: what an asset is written in, and how a plugin ships tools rather than prose.

entries.name: hosts.md
entries.title: Hosts
entries.summary: These are the platforms that read an asset, the one that runs it, and the one library a host supplies at load time. No manifest declares any of them; the checked-in files are authored for each.

entries.name: tooling.md
entries.title: Tooling
entries.summary: A plugin's executable parts run on these two runtimes. A consuming repository already has both, and nothing here installs either.
